rationale: Answers the client half of the new candidate with sources acquired by reading the previously deferred client surface. No map object changes; the two new materials are the client send and wait paths that the candidate's main unknown depended on.

feedback.answered: The client-side half of the question is answered on sources: the captured client has no retry and no reply deadline. SendProposal writes each proposal once (to the leader, or to the closest replica in the leaderless EPaxos configuration of run.go) and never re-sends it (S29-client-sendproposal). The reply path is a blocking read: WaitReplies loops on GetReplyFrom(waitFrom) and only leaves the loop when the read returns an error such as net.ErrClosed, at which point it logs and stops rather than re-sending (S28-client-waitreplies, S30-client-getreplyfrom). There is no timeout, no outstanding-request table and no CommandId-based retransmission, so a proposal whose instance was committed as NOOP by a recovery is never completed on either side: the recovering replica never held the proposals (it preserves only its own record's clientProposals), the re-propose branch requires the commit to land on the committing replica's own row with a single NONE command (S13-handleCommit), and the client does not re-issue the request.
remaining: whether the replica side could be expected to complete another replica's proposal, i.e. whether the recovering replica should adopt the owner's proposals when it recovers the owner's row (no read path does)

The replica-side mechanisms were already read and do not cover another replica's proposals. What remains is whether that absence is a defect of the replica implementation or of the test client, which is a normative question plus a construction question, and both are recorded rather than assumed.

unknowns: whether the replica implementation is expected to complete another replica's client proposal when it recovers that replica's instance (no read path adopts the owner's proposals; the re-propose branch is guarded to the committing replica's own row, S13-handleCommit)
